Body 15: rows and sentences. Bold is ink. Secondary is ink-2. Captions are ink-3.

Buttons
.btn (primary) · .btn.ghost (secondary) · .btn.subtle (quiet) · .btn.danger · .btn.success (a recorded state, never an action; full strength although disabled) · .btn.text
States: pressed (.is-pressed mirrors :active) · disabled · busy (.busy or aria-busy)
.small (44 px) · default (48 px) · .big (56 px) · .block
.btn-row: equal widths while the labels fit on one line; otherwise the row breaks and each button takes a line
.btn.block with a long label: it runs to a second line, centred, the icon with the first word
.icon-btn · .icon-btn.key · .icon-btn.danger · disabled · pressed
